title: One Scanner Transition
statement: For every syntax-scanner state $q$, bit $b$, and binary string $x$, scanning $b$ followed by $x$ from $q$ gives the same acceptance bit as scanning $x$ from the state reached by applying one transition to $q$ on $b$.
replaced:
For every state $q$ of the six-state formula syntax scanner with transition $\delta$,
every bit $b$, and every binary string $x$, the acceptance bit of the scan from $q$ on
$b :: x$ equals the acceptance bit of the scan from $\delta(q, b)$ on $x$.
